firstRead.outcome: three of four matched; one did not
firstRead.cause: The statement sent to the management API dropped the three explanatory comments from inside private.fail_own_preparation_claim_v1's body while the call was being composed. Comments inside a function body are part of prosrc, so the deployed source differed from the repository by 655 bytes with identical behaviour. Nothing else differed; the other three bodies were byte-equal on the first read.

correction.statement: create or replace function private.fail_own_preparation_claim_v1(...) with the repository body verbatim
correction.why: create or replace preserves the ACL, and the migration was already in the ledger under its own name, so a corrective statement makes the deployed body match the recorded migration rather than adding a ledger row with no file behind it.

note: The ACL survived the corrective create or replace, which is why the final read still shows service_role on both new functions: create or replace preserves a function's privileges and only a fresh create takes defaults.
